heading: INT. DECOMMISSIONED GRAIN ELEVATOR - OPEN-PLAN OFFICE - DAY

units.text: INT. DECOMMISSIONED GRAIN ELEVATOR - OPEN-PLAN OFFICE - DAY
Dust hangs in the shafts of light that fall through the old hopper doors.
Forty desks have been dropped onto the concrete in neat rows, and every one of them faces a wall of corrugated steel painted the cheerful green of a hospital.

PRUDENCE OKAFOR (50s, cardigan buttoned to the throat, lanyard heavy with laminated cards) stands before a whiteboard and caps and uncaps a marker, caps and uncaps it, as if the sound were a metronome for the room.

At the front desk sit BARNABY QUILL (30s, a tie knotted tight enough to be a verdict) and DELPHINE ROUSSEAU-ADEYEMI (late 20s, headphones around her neck, one earbud in, a half-eaten yogurt sweating at her elbow).
The Synergy Taskforce has decided, after consultation, that the synergy is insufficient.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Barnaby nods before she finishes.
Delphine peels the yogurt lid back, licks it, folds it into a perfect small square.
Insufficient in which direction?
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Directionally.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: She writes the word DIRECTIONALLY on the whiteboard.
Underlines it twice.
The marker squeaks and dies mid-line.
She looks at it with great tenderness, then sets it in the tray as if laying down a child.
Is this the meeting about the meeting?
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: This is the meeting about the meeting about the meeting.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Barnaby and Delphine both reach for the same pen at the same instant.
Their fingers touch.
They both withdraw, Barnaby smoothing his tie, Delphine tucking a strand of hair behind her ear, each looking determinedly at a different corner of the ceiling.
Somewhere above them, a pigeon walks across a rafter and drops something.
It lands on the carpet tile beside Prudence's shoe.
All three look down at it.
All three look up again.
We'll take that offline.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: I'll circulate a note.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: I'll bring a mop.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Please do not bring a mop. Mops are a Facilities line item.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Delphine slowly pulls the earbud out and lays it on the desk beside the yogurt lid.
She straightens it.
Squares it to the edge.
Prudence picks up a fresh marker.
Holds it.
Does not uncap it.
Barnaby. Your quarterly deck. Is it ready?
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: It is in a state of readiness.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: He opens his laptop.
The screen glows.
On it, a single slide: a pie chart, entirely one colour.
He angles the lid down a few degrees, and the three of them stand there in the green light of the hopper doors, pretending not to see it.
Excellent.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: She writes ACTION ITEMS on the whiteboard.
Under it, nothing.
She stands back and admires the nothing.
Do I get a lanyard?
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: After the review.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Which review?
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: The one we are about to schedule.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Barnaby and Delphine rise together, chairs scraping in unison, and file toward the elevator door that has not worked since 1987.
They arrive at it.
They stop.
They stand side by side, facing steel, and wait.
